def state(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    def wright(r): return max([c for c,ch in enumerate(a[r]) if ch=='W'], default=None)
    N=sorted(set(c for r in range(1,64) for c,ch in enumerate(a[r]) if ch=='N'))

seq=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1},{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':1}]*5

    action([act])
    s=state(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('done'); lvl=last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print(f"step{i+1} row{r}:", s, "done=",done,"lvl=",lvl)
    if done or lvl: break
